stories.title: Pedestrian hit, killed by driver on Indy's near southwest side
stories.summary: Police said the pedestrian was struck around 9:30 p.m. Nov. 22 in the 3000 block of West Morris Street, near South Tibbs Avenue.

stories.title: 2 men arrested after being caught doing cocaine in bathroom stall of Evansville bar
stories.summary: Police said an officer had to use a Taser to subdue one of the men after he allegedly pushed the officer while being placed into handcuffs.

stories.title: 1 critically injured after shooting on Indy's near northeast side
stories.summary: Police said the shooting happened shortly after 7 p.m. Nov. 22 in the 2700 block of North Tacoma Avenue, near East 25th Street and North Keystone Avenue.

stories.title: Missing 67-year-old northeastern Indiana woman found dead under 'heavy vegetation' near library
stories.summary: A statewide Silver Alert was issued Friday night for Tammy Jo Price before it was canceled Saturday afternoon.

stories.title: Investigation underway after 2 adults found dead inside northwest Indiana home
stories.summary: The sheriff's office said deputies responded to a residence in the 4000 block of North County Road 800 East in rural La Porte late Friday night for a welfare check.

stories.title: Juvenile in custody after fire destroys newly-opened Evansville playground
stories.summary: The fire was reported shortly before 2 a.m. Nov. 22 at the new Caldwell Park playground, which had opened just ten days earlier on Nov. 13.

stories.title: 1 killed after northern Indiana house becomes 'engulfed in flames'
stories.summary: Responding firefighters reported seeing flames "coming out of every window and through the roof" of the home.

stories.title: 2 hospitalized after car drives into Hancock County pond
stories.summary: According to the Buck Creek Township Fire Department, two people were in the car when it drove into a pond near North 700 West and West Lane Road.

stories.title: Pat Sullivan shares tips on how to best cook your turkey this Thanksgiving
stories.summary: Pat Sullivan is back with more home and garden tips, and this week he's sharing some advice on how to best cook your turkey this Thanksgiving.

stories.title: IMPD: Man, woman killed in apparent drive-by shooting on Indy's near northeast side
stories.summary: Police said the shooting happened around 10:40 p.m. Nov. 21 in the 3600 block of Grant Avenue, near 38th Street and North Sherman Drive.

stories.title: IMPD: Man injured after shooting on Indy's near southwest side
stories.summary: Police said the shooting happened shortly after 11:30 p.m. Nov. 21 in the 1800 block of West Miller Street, near South Harding Street.

stories.title: Portland police arrest 6 people, including juveniles, after investigation into Jay County burglary
stories.summary: Police said multiple firearms were stolen during the burglary, which reportedly occurred Nov. 17-18 at an unspecified residence in Jay County.
